body:
VERDICT: ACCEPT-WITH-NITS

Review of storyatlas4s commits 7f6e596 + 962789d against ADR 0002 section 6 (bd-01M155F3K5M3VKYV998BAG1992, read-only). The five reviewed properties hold. Marks and annotations are lowered exactly once under their MarkId / AnnotationId (names.scala:15-19; AtlasLowering.scala:88-95; CodexLowering.scala:57-69); lowering is deterministic and adds no coordinate beyond what the scene carries (V-D1/V-D2, tested WarOfTheGhostsLoweringSuite.scala:75-81,122-138); the codex row formula drops nothing and merges no identities (every annotation keeps its own named group); V-U5 holds (portal mode and route layer/status are text, not colour — AtlasLowering.scala:131-135); receipt fields are consistent with the twins (EditionSuite.scala:42-61). Findings:

1. HIGH — CodexLowering.scala:26 reads flow.source.canonicalText.length, so the Intaglio boundary holds a reference to the canonical text, violating ADR 0002 D6 and AGENTS.md (Intaglio never sees canonical text). The Atlas lowering correctly takes discourseLength: Int (AtlasLowering.scala:22; Edition.scala:107). Fix: make CodexLowering.lower take discourseLength: Int and have the CLI pass it, as it already does for the Atlas (Edition.scala:131).

2. MEDIUM — CodexLowering.scala:34-39 rowOf silently coalesces out-of-range Lane(index) via math.min and missing slots via None onto the overflow row. No annotation is dropped and no identities merge, but two annotations can land on the same row with no error if view LaneAllocation violates its invariant. Fix: fail closed (Left) when index.value >= rowsPerKind or slotOf(id).isEmpty instead of silently relocating.

3. LOW — CodexLowering.scala:71-85 kindLabels labels only the first row of each kind block; the overflow row has no label, so overflow and normal-lane annotations are indistinguishable by row label. Fix: label the last row of each block as overflow.

4. LOW — Edition.scala:113,143 set the twin names field to marks.length / annotations.length but no test asserts it equals the twin text actual name count; EditionSuite.scala:42-51 only checks each SVG name appears in the twin. Fix: assert twin.names == svg.names and that the twin contains exactly names distinct names.

5. LOW — CodexLowering.scala:87-100 header renders flow.source.title and flow.contract.horizon; the Atlas header (AtlasLowering.scala:49-60) draws only from scene.contract / zoom / checksums. Fix: drop title and horizon from the Codex header or source them from renderer-neutral fields, to match the Atlas boundary.

Recommend fixing #1 before slice 2 hardens; #2 before any non-fixture LaneAllocation is trusted.
